doc: weapon-art's station: the weapon wall in the hub. Every weapon with art (the brief's order: pistol .. mini-nuke, 16) hangs muzzle up on a paper board along the hub's north edge (x -2.5..12.5, y -3.15..-4.95), as its pickup side view at its drawn length, so the owner sees the whole arsenal in the live print beside the cops at 32-128 px/m. Render only (WeaponRackView): nothing stepped or hashed. --weapon-rack=off hides it.
